svg.aria-label: Flowchart of the revived CFC pipeline. Step 0 compiles the feeder sheet. Inside a SLURM array task run once per session and channel: read the ncs file, clean the continuous trace, detect and mask IEDs, run the filter banks and Hilbert transform on the whole recording, then cut the resulting analytic series into six second epochs. Three parallel reductions follow — modulation index per epoch, theta power per epoch, and surrogate z-scores per epoch — written to one tidy file per channel. Outside the task, everything merges to a long table feeding three outputs: MI over time, MI across theta, and the theta-power by gamma heat map, which feed a clustered model. Boxes are colour coded as reuse as-is, reuse with changes, or write new.
